svg.title: How publictransport.my puts Klang Valley transit on one live map
svg.desc: Buses report GPS positions to Prasarana's automatic vehicle location (AVL) server. That server feeds two paths. In the first, Prasarana publishes the positions as GTFS Realtime on data.gov.my; publictransport.my's server polls that protobuf feed, turns it into JSON at /api/vehicles and pushes only the buses in each user's viewport over a WebSocket. In the second, the user's browser opens the same Socket.IO connection the MyRapid Bus Kiosk uses, asks for a fresh snapshot every five seconds and decompresses the gzip reply. Trains are not tracked live: a rail estimator places LRT, MRT and Monorail trains from published headways and KTM trains from timetables, served from /api/rail/movements with a 30-second cache. OpenStreetMap data becomes Protomaps vector tiles on publictransport.my's own tile server. The phone combines all of this in React and MapLibre GL, animates vehicles between updates and tells the rider when to leave.
svg.text: How publictransport.my puts Klang Valley transit on one live map
Buses from two live Prasarana feeds, trains estimated from timetables, basemap from OpenStreetMap. Observed 31 Oct 2026, simplified.
